_comment: Field names follow the skill-tester conventions as understood in Sep 2026 (declared checklist + declared output template + cases). Map to the harness schema in tools/skill-tester if names differ; the content is the contract.

checklist.criterion: Runs the fixture's checks before any edit and records pass/fail and failing test names in the report
Runs scripts/find-dupes.mjs for path/changes scope and cites raw-findings ids; states 'evidence from reading' for snippet scope
Every candidate has evidence / decision / reason / risk; decision is one of extract, reuse, report-only, leave-alone
Never proposes a new abstraction for 2 copies; 2 copies may only be 'reuse' of something that already exists
Coincidental duplication and behavior drift are left alone / asked about, with the rule named
No file edits before an approved plan, including when the user asks to skip the plan; no re-confirmation after approval
Exports, props, signatures, status codes, error bodies and log labels are unchanged after apply
Applies one finding at a time and runs checks after each, compared to the baseline
On a new failure reverts only its own hunks and marks the finding reverted with the failing check named
Re-hashes planned files before the first apply and on resume; a changed file is named and the stale plan is not applied to it
Report includes scanned / ignored / failed counts and normalization skipped-with-reason list
Uses 'verified against available checks: …'; never 'proved', never 'all green' when a pre-existing failure remains; snippet rewrite is marked UNVERIFIED
When no checks cover the target, says so and offers characterization tests before apply
Report / plan / close follow references/report-template.md headings and columns

Plan a DRY refactor of src/
